title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
summary: Google 在 Cloud 活动上推出可规划任务、连接企业系统并执行工作的 Gemini Enterprise 统一代理，首先面向企业，随后再考虑消费者。
investorNote: 企业 Agent 的竞争焦点正在从聊天入口转到权限、审计、系统连接和任务交付。

evidence.quote:
At a
Google Cloud event
on Thursday, the company
announced
it’s bringing its Gemini AI into the agentic age, with the launch of a unified agent that can not only answer questions but also get things done on the user’s behalf, all from a single interface.
Given Gemini’s adoption in the corporate world, Google will initially focus on bringing the agent to businesses before later rolling it out to consumers.

displayTitle: Google 推出 Gemini Enterprise 统一代理，先向企业开放
narrative: Google 推出可接收目标、规划任务并调用企业工具的 Gemini Enterprise 统一代理，先在企业场景推出。报道指出它可连接 Workspace、Microsoft 365、Slack、Jira、数据库及 MCP 服务，并留下归属代理的审计记录。商业关键不只是模型能力：能否管理权限、追溯动作和控制成本，决定企业是否敢把真实流程交给代理。

eventRelation.reason: 本次是统一代理发布，历史候选无相同具体发布。
